propositions: rebar truncates DC comments at hardcoded WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) regardless of the admin-settable jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit
the comment sanitizer incorrectly depends on the description fitter fit_outbound, creating a maintenance trap where future changes to description fitting could retarget comment truncation
Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit property has a default of 32767 and a range of 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647, but rebar does not expose this as a configuration option
the /rest/api/2/application-properties endpoint is admin-only and cannot be read by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, making runtime discovery of the instance limit infeasible
comment truncation must be decoupled from description fitting so they can have independent ceiling logic appropriate to each field type
